truthClaims.claim: A Garden Worm is a rare planting bonus that occurs on roughly one in 64 accepted Community Garden plantings.
truthClaims.basis: Implemented deterministic action-ID selection in supabase/migrations/20260724013000_uncapped_care_and_heritage_flowers.sql and player copy in GardenWormDiscovery.tsx.

truthClaims.claim: A Garden Worm adds two bonus Care to the Care normally earned from planting, and retries cannot create a duplicate reward.
truthClaims.basis: Server-authoritative +2 Care mutation and idempotent action handling in the implemented migration and tests/basil-desktop-controls-and-worm.test.ts.

title: Why finding a worm is good news in Basil
summary: A rare planting-event reveal showing a Garden Worm surfacing beside a new flower and adding two bonus Care.
whyToday: Recent discovery clips covered habitats, lifespans, and Heritage. This uses a new close soil-level action, a visible creature reveal, and a counterintuitive hook from a separate server-backed system.
hook: Finding a worm is good news here.
narration: I found the rare thing I watch for while tending Basil. Roughly one in 64 accepted Community Garden plantings triggers a Garden Worm. The server derives it from the action ID, so retries cannot duplicate the reward. It adds two bonus Care. I call that lively soil.
sourceNote: The capture records Wren walking through Basil's real Community Garden canvas. The worm odds and Care reward come from the implemented action rules; the footage does not claim every planting produces a worm.

youtube.headline: Why finding a worm is good news in Basil
youtube.body: About one in 64 accepted Community Garden plantings can surface a Garden Worm. It adds +2 bonus Care to the normal planting reward, and server-side idempotency keeps retries from duplicating it.

reddit.headline: The rare Basil planting event where finding a worm is good news
reddit.body: Roughly one in 64 accepted Community Garden plantings can surface a Garden Worm. The server derives the event from the action ID, so a retry cannot duplicate it, and the worm adds +2 Care to the normal planting reward. This clip recreates the rare result so the rule is actually visible.
